data.name: Sheilah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew Shlah, meaning 'to whom God has given.' This name was given to a woman in the Old Testament who was a prophetess and the wife of the high priest. She played an important role in the history of the Israelites and was known for her devotion and prophetic abilities.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the blessings and gifts from God.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Sheilah are sensitive, compassionate, and nurturing. They are natural healers and have a strong intuition. They are also adaptable and can handle change well.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sheilah is often associated with strong and devoted women in history. Apart from the Old Testament prophetess, there have been numerous remarkable women bearing this name throughout history, including English women's rights activist, Sheila Rowbotham, and Nobel Peace Prize Laureate, Sheila Widnall. This strong association with powerful and influential women significantly impacts the cultural perception of individuals named Sheilah, inspiring them to strive for success and make their mark in the world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sheilah holds profound spiritual meaning, being derived from the Hebrew word 'Shlah', which means 'to whom God has given.' This is a reminder that each of us is uniquely blessed by God with specific talents and abilities. Carrying this name invites individuals to live in accordance with its meaning, by recognizing and utilizing their God-given gifts to serve others and make a positive impact on the world. A Sheilah can take pride in her name, knowing that she is chosen and valued by God, and that her purpose in life is to use her gifts to make a difference.
